# Compression Sale

> > Compression Sale offers premium medical-grade compression wear including socks, stockings, sleeves, and pantyhose from leading brands like JOBST, Juzo, TRUFORM, and Second Skin.

Compression Sale specializes in graduated compression hosiery for medical support, circulation improvement, and therapeutic relief. The site carries products across multiple compression levels (8-40 mmHg) and caters to diverse customer needs including pregnancy, plus-size, and athletic applications.

## Shop by Compression Level

- [Women's 8-15mmHg](https://www.compressionsale.com/collections/womens-8-15mmhg): Light compression socks for women with gentle leg support and relief
- [Women's 15-20mmHg](https://www.compressionsale.com/collections/womens-15-20mmhg): Moderate compression for women ideal for travel and mild varicose veins
- [Women's 20-30mmHg](https://www.compressionsale.com/collections/womens-20-30mmhg): Firm compression socks for women with moderate to severe varicose veins
- [Women's 30-40mmHg](https://www.compressionsale.com/collections/womens-30-40mmhg): Extra firm compression for chronic venous insufficiency and lymphedema
- [Men's 8-15 mmHg Compression Socks](https://www.compressionsale.com/collections/mens-8-15mmhg): Men's light compression socks for everyday comfort and circulation
